verdict.rationale: Gitea is documented as a free, MIT-licensed self-hosted Git service. Install paths cover a single binary or the official container image, it runs on many OSes and architectures (including Kubernetes), and it supports multiple databases. Configuration is done through the admin panel or app.ini plus a restart. Community users corroborate painless installs, simple binary-swap upgrades, and years of stable, low-resource operation. Missing for 10: first-party upgrade and backup/restore documentation (a community user questioned backup/restore and one reported breaking changes in the 1.17 upgrade), and stronger official admin docs (one user cites a lack of good documentation).
